channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Como oo Lens ku garaacday 9-1, waxayna la siman tahay rikoorka Champions League
item.description: Kooxda Como ee uu tababaro Cesc Fàbregas ayaa garoonka Lens kaga adkaatay 9-1, iyadoo Anastasios Douvikas uu dhaliyay saddex gool, sida ay werisay Irish Examiner. Sagaalka gool ayaa la siman tirada ugu badan ee hal kooxeed ku dhalisay ciyaar Champions League, kaddib guushii Bayern Munich ee 9-2 ay ka gaartay Dinamo Zagreb 2024.

item.title: QM: Rasaas ayaa waxyeellaysay teendhooyin barakacayaal oo ku yaal Rafah
item.description: Xafiiska Isku-duwidda Gargaarka ee QM (OCHA) ayaa sheegay in rasaas ay ku dhacday oo ay waxyeellaysay teendhooyin badan oo ku yaal goob barakacayaal oo ku taal waqooyiga Rafah ee Gaza, isla markaana dad ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay werisay UN News. Afhayeenka Xoghayaha Guud Stephane Dujarric ayaa sheegay in rayidka iyo shaqaalaha gargaarka ay tahay in la ilaaliyo.

item.title: Champions League: Real Madrid oo AEK ku garaacday 3-2, Liverpool oo Fenerbahce 3-2 looga adkaaday
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa garoonka AEK Athens kaga adkaatay 3-2 kaddib gool daqiiqadihii dheeriga ahaa uu dhaliyay Federico Valverde, iyadoo Jude Bellingham iyo Kylian Mbappé ay sidoo kale dhaliyeen, sida ay werisay bogga rasmiga ah ee Real Madrid. Liverpool ayaa Istanbul looga adkaaday 3-2, iyadoo Muriqi uu goolka guusha u dhaliyay Fenerbahce, sida uu xaqiijiyay bogga Liverpool.

item.title: UNCTAD: Dalalka soo koraya ayaa ugu culays badan qiimaha shidaalka
item.description: Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay UNCTAD ayaa sheegtay in dalalka soo koraya ay ugu culays badnaayeen kororka qiimaha shidaalka ka dib markii dagaalku xiray Marinka Hormuz bishii Febraayo, sida ay werisay UN News. Tusaale ahaan, naaftada Nigeria ayaa qiyaastii 83% kor u kacday intii u dhaxaysay dhammaadkii Febraayo iyo dhammaadkii Agoosto, halka Ireland ay ku kordhay 9%.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo xilka ka qaaday Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare
item.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xilka ka qaaday Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare Baashe Yuusuf Axmed, wuxuuna booskiisa u magacaabay Ibraahim Iidle Suleymaan, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada oo ay werisay Dawan Africa. Madaxtooyada ayaa sheegtay in go'aanka lagu salaynayo cabashooyin ka yimid garsoorayaal iyo xirfadlayaal sharci, halka Somali Guardian ay werisay in mucaaradku ay ku tilmaameen tallaabadan mid wiiqaysa madaxbannaanida garsoorka.

item.title: Weerarro diyaaradaha drone-ka ah oo saddex qof ku dilay gobolka Belgorod ee Ruushka
item.description: Mas'uuliyiinta maxalliga ah ee Ruushka ayaa sheegay in weerarro drone oo Ukraine ah ay saddex qof ku dileen gobolka Belgorod, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa sheegay in weerarradii habeenkii ee Ruushku ay waxyeelleeyeen xarumo koronto iyo saldhigyo tamar oo ku yaal sagaal gobol, taasoo keentay go'itaan koronto.

item.title: Trump: Dagaalka Iiraan wuu saameeyay doorashada, laakiin waxaan sameeyay waxa saxda ah
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa qiray in weerarka Iiraan iyo qiimaha sare ee shidaalku ay saameeyeen khasaaraha Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee doorashada xilli-dhexaadka, balse wuxuu u sheegay Wall Street Journal: "Waxaan sameeyay waxa saxda ah," sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha JD Vance ayaa isna ku qoray X in sababta looga guuldarraystay ay tahay dagaalka.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo meel marisay qorshe lix bilood ah oo lagu gaarayo carruurta aan la tallaalin
item.description: Guddiga Qaranka ee Tallaalka iyo Ciribtirka Dabaysha oo uu shir guddoominayay Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa ansixiyay qorshe lix bilood ah oo lagu ballaarinayo tallaalka carruurta, sida ay werisay Dawan Africa. Sida ay sheegeen WHO iyo UNICEF, ilaa 1.5 milyan oo carruur Soomaaliyeed ah oo ka yar shan sano ayaan weligood helin tallaal joogto ah.

item.title: Xiriirka Xeegada Barafka ee Caalamka oo weli diidan go'aanka dib loogu soo celiyay Ruushka
item.description: Xiriirka Xeegada Barafka ee Caalamka (IIHF) ayaa sheegay inuu weli ku diidan yahay go'aanka Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ee meesha ka saaray mamnuucii Ruushka, isagoo ka digay caqabado la xiriira fiisooyinka iyo amniga, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Norway, Denmark, Sweden iyo Czech Republic ayaa sheegay in kooxahoodu aysan la ciyaari doonin Ruushka Koobka Adduunka ee sanadka dambe ka dhacaya Jarmalka.

item.title: Rory McIlroy oo taageeray in ciyaartoydii LIV dib loogu oggolaado DP World Tour
item.description: Xiddigga golf-ka Rory McIlroy ayaa taageeray go'aanka DP World Tour ee ah in ciyaartoydii hore ee LIV Golf sida Jon Rahm iyo Sergio Garcia dib loogu oggolaado 2027, sida ay werisay ESPN. McIlroy ayaa sheegay in LIV ay xirfadda golf-ka u rogtay 'tartan hub', isagoo ku baaqay hab ganacsi oo waara.

item.title: Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga oo la wareegay labada aqal ee Congress-ka Mareykanka
item.description: Dimuqraadiyiintu waxay dib ula wareegeen Aqalka Wakiillada waxayna Golaha Guurtida ka qabsadeen ugu yaraan lix kursi, taasoo siisay maamulka Congress-ka oo dhan, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuusan codbixinta ku jirin, halka Hakeem Jeffries uu ku tilmaamay natiijada bilowga soo laabashada Mareykanka.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed oo noqday senetarkii ugu horreeyay ee Muslim ah ee Mareykanka
item.description: Musharraxa Dimuqraadiga Abdul El-Sayed ayaa kaga guuleystay Mike Rogers kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee gobolka Michigan, wuxuuna noqonayaa senetarkii ugu horreeyay ee Muslim ah ee dalkaas, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. El-Sayed, 42 jir oo waalidkiis ka soo haajireen Masar, ayaa sheegay in ololihiisu muujiyay in 'dadka badani ay ka adkaan karaan lacagta'.

item.title: Wasiirka Gaadiidka Isbaanishka oo is casilay kadib shil tareen oo dilay 69 qof
item.description: Wasiir Óscar Puente ayaa is casilay wax ka yar toddobaad kadib shilkii tareenka ee khadka Madrid iyo Seville, wuxuuna sheegay in wasiir aanu xilka sii hayn karin kadib laba shil oo culus muddo sanad gudihiis ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Ra'iisul Wasaare Pedro Sánchez ayaa ku dhawaaqay gargaar dhan €30 milyan.

item.title: Koonfur Afrika oo u codeysay doorashooyinka golaha deegaanka, imtixaan u ah ANC
item.description: Guddiga doorashooyinka IEC ayaa sheegay in 29.2 milyan oo qof oo rikoor ah ay isu diiwaangeliyeen codbixinta golayaasha deegaanka, taasoo loo arko imtixaan u ah xisbiga ANC, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa ayaa qoray in fashilka dowladaha hoose uu hoos u dhigay kalsoonida shacabka; natiijada kama dambaysta ah waxaa la filayaa Axadda.

item.title: Xiddiggii baseball-ka Mark Teixeira oo ku guuleystay kursi Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka
item.description: Mark Teixeira, oo saddex jeer ka qayb galay ciyaarta All-Star ee MLB, ayaa xisbiga Jamhuuriga ugu guuleystay kursiga degmada 21aad ee gobolka Texas, isagoo ka adkaaday Dimuqraadiga Kristin Hook, sida ay werisay ESPN. Kursigan waxaa horay u hayay Chip Roy oo aan dib u tartamin.

item.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo diiday safiirka Israa'iil u magacawday Hargeysa iyo safaaradda la qorsheeyay
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ayaa sheegtay in magacaabista safiirka iyo dhagax-dhigga safaarad Israa'iil ka furto Hargeysa aan la helin oggolaanshaha dowladda federaalka oo aysan lahayn wax saameyn sharci ah. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed, siyaasadeed iyo sharci, waxayna ugu baaqday Israa'iil inay dib uga noqoto, sida ay werisay Horseed Media.

item.title: Jon Ossoff oo dib ugu guuleystay kursiga Senate-ka ee gobolka Georgia
item.description: Senetar Jon Ossoff oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ayaa doorashada dhexe ee Mareykanka kaga adkaaday musharraxa Jamhuuriga Mike Collins, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Markii 56% codadka la tiriyay, Ossoff wuxuu helay 63% halka Collins helay 29%, sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda AP; xisbiga maamuli doona labada aqal ee Congress-ka weli lama shaacin.

item.title: Golaha Wakiillada Puntland oo su'aalo weydiiyay madaxda Wasaaradda Waxbarashada
item.description: Golaha Wakiillada Puntland oo uu shir guddoominayay Guddoomiye Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid ayaa dhageystay warbixinta Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Tacliinta Sare, kadibna xildhibaanno ayaa su'aalo ka weydiiyay waxqabadka iyo adeegyada waxbarashada, sida ay werisay Horseed Media.

item.title: Ilhan Cumar oo markii shanaad loo doortay Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka
item.description: Xildhibaan Ilhan Cumar oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ayaa dib loogu doortay kursiga degmada 5aad ee gobolka Minnesota, oo ay matalaysay tan iyo 2019, sida ay werisay Horseed Media. Khudbaddeeda guusha ayay ugu mahadcelisay taageerayaasheeda, oo badankood Soomaali ah.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga milatari iyo amniga
item.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay Jeneraal Sabahattin Kılınç oo ka socda taliska guud ee ciidamada Turkiga, waxayna ka wada hadleen iskaashiga difaaca, amniga Geeska Afrika iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, sida ay werisay Horseed Media. Fiqi ayaa ammaanay taageerada Turkiga ee tababarka iyo qalabeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed.

item.title: Dowladda: Bixitaanka ciidamada Uganda micnaheedu maaha in dhammaan ciidamadeedu baxayaan
item.description: Lataliyaha Amniga Qaranka Safiir Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf Axmed ayaa sheegay in ciidamada baxaya ay yihiin kuwa la keenay heshiis laba dal, halka ciidamada Uganda ee AUSSOM ay sii joogi doonaan, sida ay werisay Garowe Online. Ciidamada UPDF ayaa horay u sheegay in dhammaan ciidamadooda Soomaaliya ay bixi doonaan dhammaadka 2027.

item.title: Boqor Charles oo ka muujiyay murugo qoto dheer ganacsigii addoonsiga, balse aan raali-gelin bixin
item.description: Boqorka Ingiriiska Charles III ayaa furitaanka shirka madaxda Barwaaqo-sooranka (CHOGM) ee St John's, Antigua iyo Barbuda, ka sheegay in ganacsigii addoonsiga ee Atlantic-ga uu ku abuuray naxdin iyo murugo shakhsi ah oo qoto dheer, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Ma uusan bixin raali-gelin rasmi ah, halka Madaxweynaha Guyana Mohamed Irfaan Ali uu sheegay in raali-gelintu ay noqoto tallaabada xigta.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Greenland oo ansixiyay heshiis amni oo lala galay Mareykanka iyo Denmark
item.description: Baarlamaanka Greenland ayaa Talaadadii heshiiska ku ansixiyay 16 cod oo haa ah iyo 0 diid ah, iyadoo 7 xildhibaan ay ka aamuseen, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Heshiisku wuxuu Mareykanka u oggolaanayaa inuu ballaariyo hawlihiisa saldhigga Pituffik Space Base, wuxuuna dhaqan geli doonaa marka baarlamaanka Denmark iyo Greenland ay dhammaystiraan nidaamyada loo baahan yahay.

item.title: Barcelona oo 3-0 ku garaacday Aston Villa, PSG oo 6-0 ku jebisay Villarreal
item.description: Lamine Yamal (daqiiqadda 7aad) iyo Raphinha oo laba gool dhaliyay (52 iyo 64) ayaa Barcelona u keenay guusha Champions League-ka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Natiijooyinka kale ee habeenkaas oo uu xaqiijiyay bogga rasmiga ah ee UEFA waxaa ka mid ah Manchester United 3-2 Roma, Villarreal 0-6 Paris Saint-Germain iyo Atlético de Madrid 0-2 Bayern München.

item.title: Zelensky oo rajeynaya in wadahadallada Abu Dhabi ay u horseedaan kulan uu la yeesho Putin
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo Berlin kula kulmay Jaanseler Friedrich Merz ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo in wadahadallada Abu Dhabi ee 10 iyo 11 November ay waddo u furaan kulan saddex geesood ah oo heer madaxeed ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Ergayga gaarka ah ee Mareykanka Steve Witkoff ayaa ku dhawaaqay wadahadallada, halka Kremlin-ku sheegay in ergada Ruushka uu hoggaamin doono Vladimir Medinsky.

item.title: Madasha Badbaadinta Qaranka oo aqbashay wada-hadal lala yeesho Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
item.description: Mucaaradka ayaa sheegay inay madaxweynaha siinayaan fursad kama dambays ah oo lagu xalliyo khilaafka doorashada iyo dastuurka, waxayna magacaabeen guddi 3 xubnood ah oo 14-ka bishan la kulmi doona guddiga farsamada ee dowladda. Somali Guardian ayaa werisay in aan weli la ogeyn in Puntland iyo Jubaland ay ka qayb geli doonaan.

item.title: Ugu yaraan 73 qof oo ku dhaawacmay duqeyn Ruushku ku qaaday isbitaal ku yaal Kharkiv
item.description: Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa sheegay in Ruushku habeennimadii weerar ku qaaday isbitaal iyo xarumo koronto oo ku yaal gobollo badan oo Ukraine ah, isagoo adeegsaday 289 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, 17 gantaal oo ballistic ah iyo 59 gantaal oo cruise ah. Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa sheegtay inay beegsatay xarumo koronto oo quudiya ciidamada iyo warshadaha milatariga ee Ukraine.

item.title: Codbixinta doorashada xilli-dhexaadka Mareykanka oo bilaabatay
item.description: Al Jazeera ayaa werisay in codbixintu ay go'aamin doonto dhammaan 435 kursi ee Aqalka Wakiilada, 35 ka mid ah 100 kursi ee Golaha Guurtida iyo xilka guddoomiyaha 36 gobol, iyadoo loo arkayo imtixaan u ah Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Waaxda Caddaaladda ayaa sheegtay inay geysay 1,000 kormeere oo doorasho dhammaan 50-ka gobol.

item.title: Jesús de Miguel, ciyaaryahanka Tenerife, oo geeriyooday kadib isku dhac garoonka dhexdiisa
item.description: Kooxda Tenerife ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday geerida weeraryahankeeda 30 jirka ah, kaas oo dhaawac ka soo gaaray isku dhac uu la galay goolhayaha Andorra, Jesús Owono, ciyaartii La Liga 2 ee Isniintii. Ciyaarta oo 2-2 ahayd ayaa la joojiyay, Owono-na waxaa la tusay kaar casaan ah; warka waxaa xaqiijiyay Al Jazeera iyo ESPN.

item.title: Ciidamada Uganda oo amniga Baraawe iyo Shalanbood u wareejiyay ciidanka xoogga dalka
item.description: Somali Guardian ayaa sheegtay in wareejintan ay soo afjartay joogitaan milatari oo ka badan toban sano oo Uganda ku lahayd labada magaalo ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Afhayeenka ciidamada Uganda, Korneyl Chris Magezi, ayaa sheegay in dhammaan ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya, kuwa AUSSOM ku jira oo ay ku jiraan, ay si tallaabo-tallaabo ah uga bixi doonaan dhammaadka 2027.
